headline: Election Commission Official’s Last-Minute Cancellation Leaves Chhattisgarh Catering Staff With 4,000 Untouched Vegetable Cutlets
body:
“I spent three days carving ‘Democracy’ into radishes, but now they’re just sitting in the walk-in fridge next to the chutney, mocking me,” said Ramesh, the head banquet coordinator for the state guest house.

“My brother-in-law bought five kilos of extra paneer specifically for this delegation, and now he’s asking if I think the Election Commission covers ‘refrigerated losses’ in their travel budget,” lamented local vegetable wholesaler Sunita.

“The security detail told us the high-profile visit was ‘postponed,’ so now I have to distribute these leftover samosas to the stray dogs, but even they are starting to look at me like they’re tired of the deep-fried lifestyle,” remarked a nearby traffic police constable.

“I had a perfectly choreographed welcome dance routine prepared for the motorcade, but now I’m just performing it for the confused auto-rickshaw drivers at the junction who think I’m having a medical emergency,” admitted a local cultural academy student.

“Honestly, the most disappointing part is that we didn’t even get to use the fancy gold-plated tongs we rented from the city specifically for the tea service,” sighed the guest house housekeeping lead.
caption: When the high-level delegation cancels, the only thing left to defend is the buffet. A culinary tragedy in four thousand parts. #Chhattisgarh #Elections #FoodWaste #Satire (satire)
igHook: Tag someone who would be more upset about the wasted snacks than the cancelled meeting.
imagePrompt: A large, empty banquet hall with rows of pristine, unused stainless steel chafing dishes and decorative vegetable carvings sitting on a long table.

sourceHeadline.title: CEC Gyanesh Kumar postpones 2-day Chhattisgarh visit

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Candidate 3 is the only one that avoids the 'bureaucrat with a weird hobby/missing item' trap that plagued the other entries. By focusing on the tangible, absurd consequence of a cancellation (4,000 radish-carved cutlets), it anchors the satire in a concrete, humorous image that feels human and avoids the cynical tropes of institutional incompetence.

safetyVerdict.reasoning: The article uses fictional characters to highlight a trivial and humorous situation regarding food waste after a cancelled event. It avoids naming real private individuals or specific public figures, and the image prompt is generic and safe.
